mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_reports ( reporter_member_id, resource_type, resource_id, report_reason ) VALUES ( #{command.reporterMemberId}, #{command.resourceType}, #{command.resourceId}, #{command.reportReason} )
mapper.select: SELECT report_image_id AS reportImageId, report_id AS reportId, image_url AS imageUrl, display_order AS displayOrder FROM community_report_images WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND report_image_id = #{reportImageId}

SELECT ri.report_image_id AS reportImageId, ri.report_id AS reportId, ri.image_url AS imageUrl, ri.display_order AS displayOrder FROM community_report_images ri INNER JOIN community_reports r ON r.report_id = ri.report_id WHERE ri.report_id = #{reportId} AND r.reporter_member_id = #{reporterMemberId} ORDER BY ri.display_order
SELECT report_image_id AS reportImageId, report_id AS reportId, image_url AS imageUrl, display_order AS displayOrder FROM community_report_images WHERE report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY display_order

SELECT report_id AS reportId, reporter_member_id AS reporterMemberId, resource_type AS resourceType, resource_id AS resourceId FROM community_reports WHERE resource_type = #{resourceType} AND resource_id = #{resourceId} AND report_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY report_id

SELECT report_id AS reportId, reporter_member_id AS reporterMemberId, resource_type AS resourceType, resource_id AS resourceId FROM community_reports WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND report_status = 'PENDING'
mapper.update: UPDATE community_reports SET report_status = #{reportStatus}, handled_by_member_id = #{handledByMemberId}, handled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND report_status = 'PENDING'
